payload.title: Prepare Hyperswitch card-vault annotation packet
payload.description: Evaluate juspay/hyperswitch-card-vault at pinned commit abfca8e078039582460335be73341699ee826615 as a Rust PCI and cardholder-data candidate. Verify repository identity and license, define a manageable complete scope around src/routes/data/types.rs or a justified enclosing directory, inventory all included source and exclusions, and prepare scanner-independent proposed annotations for applicable layers. Include positive, negative, ambiguous, evidence, rationale, and provenance records. Unsupported Rust scanning must later report unread rather than a clean negative. Keep all annotations proposed pending human review.
